transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling extremely depressed, sad, and empty inside for about a year now. I have completely lost all my energy and motivation, which is why I finally decided to come to the clinic today.
Have you ever had periods lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—extremely energetic, happy, or hyperactive, perhaps needing very little sleep?
No, I have never felt that way at all. I have mostly just felt completely down, exhausted, and empty inside. I can't even imagine having that kind of energy.
During this past year, have you ever heard or seen things that others couldn't, or held strong beliefs that other people told you weren't real or made no sense?

Yes, I actually have experienced some unusual things like that over the past year. I've heard voices when no one else was around, and I've had strong beliefs that others told me weren't real. These things only seem to happen when my depression is at its worst.
Have you ever experienced those voices or unusual beliefs during a time when you were not feeling depressed, lasting for at least two weeks?
No, I have never experienced them when my mood was normal. The voices and those thoughts only happen when I am feeling deeply depressed. I've never had them during a time when I felt okay.
